finding.claim: Lexer.blockTokens unconditionally sets state.top=true on return, and Tokenizer.list sets state.top=false for items without saving/restoring, so a nested list clobbers the outer list-item context and subsequent tokens in the same item are lexed as top-level.
finding.title: Nested blockTokens clobbers state.top

verifier.reason: Lexer.ts:309-310 unconditionally sets this.state.top=true on blockTokens return, Tokenizer.ts:518-520 sets this.lexer.state.top=false before blockTokens for each list item without saving/restoring it, and Lexer.ts:273 gates paragraph lexing on this.state.top, so a nested list's return leaves the outer item lexed as top-level.
